officialText:
Every licensed elevator agency shall have a place of business within the city in conformance with department rules and regulations. A licensed elevator inspection agency director shall be allowed to associate his or her license with only one other elevator inspection agency. Such businesses shall be located at the same place of business

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022; Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126 and L.L. 2023/077.
